hooks.text: 队员既是角色也是数字，可以相加、相乘、克隆或相除来击败对应数值的怪物。
hooks.excerpt: Add up, multiply, clone, and divide your party members to beat the monsters on your path!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 每场遭遇都是代数逻辑题，推进后会解锁更多运算和特殊能力来改写队伍数值。
hooks.excerpt: Every encounter is a puzzle to be solved with logic and simple algebra! Get access to more mathematical operations as you progress, expand your party, and gain special powers, so that you may manipulate your party's values to match the enemies'.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 三个区域各有专属怪物和首领，并能在开局前自由开关四项难度修正。
hooks.excerpt: The game features 3 different areas to complete, each with their unique monsters and boss to beat, with 4 difficulty modifiers​ which you can toggle on or off before starting an area.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
